rows.grounds: conclusive particle referring to the preceding method
bahuvrihi compound describing the practitioner as one whose mantra is perfected
agent possessing and employing the mantra
compound locating action in barren terrain: maru-ādi (desert-etc.) + nirjala (waterless) + sthala (place)

items.question: What capability does mantra accomplishment grant the practitioner in barren environments?
premises: The preceding method establishes a purifying and empowering efficacy.
A practitioner whose mantra is accomplished possesses this efficacy.
Desert and other waterless places ordinarily present severe obstacles.
items.inference: Mantra accomplishment enables the practitioner to operate effectively even in desert and other waterless places.
uncertainties: The specific activity implied in such places is unstated and supplied by context.
items.plain_english: Thus the practitioner whose mantra is accomplished can act even in a desert or other waterless place.
